name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabs with a gliding indicator (underline or pill) and panels that cross-fade 6px in the direction of travel while their container's height springs. Base UI Tabs behaviour.
docs: Import Tabs, TabsList, Tab, TabsPanels and TabsPanel from components/eased/tabs/tabs. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
